fixed_defects: Existing present-target retry replay now requires versioned MODIFY before and after SHA256 and Git blob attestations, task/proposal/path joins, original present baseline receipt, and actual clean Git baseline evidence.
Unchanged present target remains valid when a seed only concerns a different output; a selected attested target reverted to its preimage fails.
Malformed or duplicate sibling output rows fail closed instead of escaping through unhashable carrier data.
Git baseline traversal has one monotonic deadline and a 64-component limit rather than independent unbounded per-component waits.
Root and child HEAD currentness is checked again after baseline traversal; candidate raw bytes are re-read with the bounded contained snapshot reader.
Git reads scrub caller Git overrides and disable lazy fetching, replacement objects, prompts, and optional lock writes.
